info.name: Sanad Admin — Community moderation
info.description: Content moderation for Community posts. Requires a normal JWT with ContentAdmin or SuperAdmin role. Run only against disposable fixtures.

item.name: Publish pending post
item.description: ContentAdmin or SuperAdmin only. Returns 204 and makes the post visible to authenticated Community reads. Unknown or invalid-state posts return the standard problem response.

item.name: Reject pending post
item.description: ContentAdmin or SuperAdmin only. Returns 204; rejected posts remain hidden from public Community reads.

item.name: List categories (admin)
item.description: ContentAdmin or SuperAdmin only. All categories including inactive, with isActive and timestamps.

item.name: Create category
item.description: ContentAdmin or SuperAdmin only. Returns 201 with the created item. Names are required (1–200 chars); invalid names return 400 Community.Category.Invalid. Capture the returned id as categoryId.

item.name: Update category
item.description: Renames and toggles isActive. Returns 200 with the updated item. Unknown ids return 404 Community.CategoryNotFound.

item.name: Delete category
item.description: Hard delete. Returns 204. Unknown ids return 404 Community.CategoryNotFound; categories referenced by posts return 409 Community.CategoryInUse.
